subject: [jpeg] opus-jpeg: payload-heic-measure STAGED (CMPhoto hvc1 trace) + 3 small edits in gpu/video + build_plugins.sh; JPEG_INTEGRATION.md
body: (1) jp1-jpeg result chain: gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/phone/phone_report.py NAME [--fetch] writes a per-run block into JPEG_PHONE_TEST.md section 9. (2) payload-heic-measure (tag hm1-heic, rootfs only, REHEARSAL_OK): Slim.videoencoder 20ee0aa6 = build_plugins.sh product + gpu/hwcodec/heicm/n2vt_trace.c, a forwarding proxy around VCPHEVC that logs every VT call/property (tiles vs frames, sizes, CFCopyDescription of values) to /private/var/db/nord2-video/trace/<prog>-<pid>.log, only while /private/var/db/nord2-video-trace exists; switches trace+probe(n2vt_probe)+camera-keephevc on, claim-hw/hwdec off, all vcodec gates off. Trigger: phone.py scenario photo; reader heicm/heic_report.py. Host: N2TEST HEICM PASS, gpu/video WP01 31/31 still PASS. EDITS OUTSIDE MY DIR (gpu/video owner + lead please note, all no-ops for existing builds): gpu/video/vt/n2vt_shim.c: weak n2vt_trace_wrap() hook before the HEVC registration (NULL in every normal build); gpu/video/build_ios.sh: -U _n2vt_trace_wrap when absent (same pattern as n2hwenc_register_all); gpu/hwcodec/ios/build_plugins.sh: optional N2HW_PLUGIN_EXTRA_SRC / N2HW_PLUGIN_EXTRA_SYMS. stage-vcodec.sh: --on none; video switch names trace/probe/camera-keephevc (guest/undo/rehearse follow). (3) gpu/hwcodec/JPEG_INTEGRATION.md (Fable research, spot-checked): applejpeg_encode_* GOT rebinding/interposing is dead (stub islands), kernel DYLD_INSERT mechanism not in tree; recommended hook = wrap -[BWCMPhotoCompressionSession addMainImage:metadata:options:] in mediaserverd via the camera bundle's existing method_setImplementation wrap(); first step = a logging-only wrap boot.
